# GSE182109 scRNAseq Analysis

## Library
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(stringr)
```

## Load Data

```{r}

data_root <- "/Data/Inputs/GSE182109"

# list immediate subfolders (should be GSM* folders if you reorganized)
sample_dirs <- list.dirs(data_root, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

# keep only GSM sample folders
sample_dirs <- sample_dirs[grepl("^GSM[0-9]+_", basename(sample_dirs))]

cat("Found", length(sample_dirs), "sample folders\n")
head(basename(sample_dirs), 10)

# sanity check: pick the first sample and list its files
if (length(sample_dirs) > 0) {
  cat("\nExample sample:", basename(sample_dirs[1]), "\n")
  print(list.files(sample_dirs[1]))
}

```
## QC

Set parameters

```{r}
qc_params <- list(
  min_features = 300,
  max_features = 6000,
  min_counts   = 500,
  max_mt       = 20
)
```

QC filter function
```{r}
qc_filter <- function(s, p) {
  subset(
    s,
    subset =
      nFeature_RNA >= p$min_features &
      nFeature_RNA <= p$max_features &
      nCount_RNA   >= p$min_counts &
      percent.mt   <= p$max_mt
  )
}

```

```{r}

parse_sample_meta <- function(sample_id) {
  # Example: GSM5518596_rGBM-01-A
  rest <- str_split(sample_id, "_", simplify = TRUE)[2]

  tumor_group <- str_extract(rest, "^[A-Za-z]+")
  patient     <- str_match(rest, "-([0-9]{1,2})")[,2]
  replicate   <- str_extract(rest, "[^-]+$")

  list(
    tumor_group = tumor_group,
    patient     = patient,
    replicate   = replicate
  )
}

```

Load and QC all samples

```{r}

data_root <- "/Data/Inputs/GSE182109"
sample_dirs <- list.dirs(data_root, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
sample_dirs <- sample_dirs[grepl("^GSM", basename(sample_dirs))]

seu_list <- list()

for (d in sample_dirs) {

  sample_id <- basename(d)
  message("Loading ", sample_id)

  # Load counts
  counts <- Read10X(data.dir = d)

  s <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts,
    project = "GSE182109",
    min.cells = 3
  )

  # Add metadata
  meta <- parse_sample_meta(sample_id)
  s$sample_id   <- sample_id
  s$tumor_group <- meta$tumor_group
  s$patient     <- meta$patient
  s$replicate   <- meta$replicate

  # QC metrics
  s[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(s, pattern = "^MT-")

  # Store pre-QC cell count
  s$preQC_cells <- ncol(s)

  # Apply QC
  s <- qc_filter(s, qc_params)

  seu_list[[sample_id]] <- s

  # Free memory aggressively
  rm(counts)
  gc()
}

```

### Drop LGG Samples

```{r}
# check groups present
table(sapply(seu_list, function(x) unique(x$tumor_group)))

seu_list_gbm <- seu_list[
  sapply(seu_list, function(x) unique(x$tumor_group) != "LGG")
]

length(seu_list_gbm)

```

```{r}
rm(seu_list)
gc()

```
## Normalize and find variable features

```{r}
length(seu_list_gbm)
table(sapply(seu_list_gbm, function(x) unique(x$tumor_group)))

```

```{r}
seu_list_gbm <- lapply(seu_list_gbm, function(s) {
  s <- NormalizeData(s, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 1e4, verbose = FALSE)
  s
})

```
